C1194.title: XuShui Procuratorate Handles Li's SMS Bombing Software Sales Case
C1194.summary: Between August 2023 and November 2025, Li purchased SMS bombing software at low cost online and advertised it on platforms like Kuaishou and Douyin to resell at a markup or directly offer SMS bombing services.
